## 2026-11-23: Terms and Privacy way back (fix helper)

- **Cause:** this lane made `returnLeagueFor` (return-league.ts) lead "Back to {league}" to the league home for sign-in; Terms and Privacy use the same helper, so with scripts off they no longer led back to the page in `from`.
- **Cure (product):** the helper takes `to: 'home' | 'page'` (home by default); Terms and Privacy pass `'page'`, sign-in keeps the home. Unit test beside it. Build branch merged in first (no conflicts).
- **Proved:** terms-privacy 92 checks; `test:web` 226; harmful-text 2095; the lane's 10 browser files all pass; `check`, typecheck, prettier on changed files pass.
